big_case.notes: While every scheduled execution carries grave life-or-death stakes for the applicant and the underlying 2001 Rob Andrew murder had prior capital-litigation visibility through co-defendant Brenda Andrew's case, this third successive state post-conviction stay application was procedurally barred below under Okla. Stat. tit. 22, section 1089(D)(8) and ended in a routine, unexplained two-sentence denial of both the stay and certiorari with no noted dissents, no separate writings, and no doctrinal or institutional impact.

leakage.notes: Forward prediction placed on 2026-11-09 (~22:48-23:00 UTC) while the application was genuinely unresolved ahead of the 2026-11-12 denial. All 47 logged tool calls carry result_capture = 'outcome_only' (result_capture_coverage = 0.0); queries inspected only the provisioned arrival snapshot and application, prior SCOTUS dockets, and pre-existing CourtListener records (Pavatt's 2007/2019/2020 appeals, co-defendant Brenda Andrew's 2025/Jan. 2026 decisions, and an Oct. 23, 2026 D.D.C. complaint). No post-resolution material or qp-topics files were accessed.
